I can't help but answer when people ask me who I\nam! Nice to meet you if you dunno know me! I'm one\nof the guys you'll be facing in an epic battle!
I haven't done anything yet though?! This is a\nserious case of defamation! I'm just excited about\nthe battle, what's so annoying about it?!
A special annual martial arts competition is held!\nIt's a battle of power, technique, and speed!\nLet your fire burn hotter than the summer sun!
I'm burning in my armor too, hot enough to make a\nsunny side up egg!! Somehow my vision is shaking,\nwhat is it, I bet the stage has been set!!
It feels like my body heat has permeated my mind!!\nI'm totally ready for the special martial arts\ncompetition!!
C'mon!! You should let it burn too!!\nFind that spark inside, and set it ablaze!!\nUnleash the fire inside you!!
Great!! Embrace that fire inside you!!\nLet your opponents see the fire that will never\nbe overcome!!
Now, bring that spirit to the special martial arts\ncompetition!! See how far you can get for\nyourself!!
What are you saying?! The real competition starts\nafter you've given it your all!! A passionate\nheart knows no limit!! That's for you to prove!!
Hmm, I don't wanna do it.
Good decision!! The fire inside you may be weak\nnow, but it'll soon become scorching hot! Let your\nopponents see the flame that's burning inside you!
Hmph?! It seems like you haven't realized the fire\ninside you...! This is the only place you can let\nit burn, you know!!
Still, I don't wanna do it.
Fine then, I guess I can do nothing about it...\nI don't wanna fight a passionless and unmotivated\nadventurer like you either!
